text: This video follows a warranty claim out of Setup and into an actual Tuesday on Hannah Reyes's and Tobias Lindgren's Service teams.
A rep logs the claim, Warranty_Claim_Auto_Routing sends it to the right region instantly, and a rep works it through to approval or denial.
Reps see their own region's queue; managers now see their whole region, thanks to the Role Hierarchy fix making the sharing rule finally work as designed.
Two honest boundaries: no customer can check their own claim online yet, and no claim escalates itself automatically past its SLA window.
Next: writing the real admin documentation and handoff, so this system outlives any one person's memory of how it works.
